intro.en: Two friends talk about meals. You will learn the three meals of the day, foods like fish, rice and bread, and how to say 'a lot' and 'a little'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do dost khaane ke baare mein baat karte hain. Hum din ke teen khaane, machli, chawal aur roti jaise naam, aur 'bohat' aur 'thora' kehna seekhenge.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ صَديقانِ عَنِ الوَجَباتِ. تَتَعَلَّمُ وَجَباتِ اليَوْمِ الثَّلاثَ، وَأَطْعِمَةً مِثْلَ السَّمَكِ وَالأَرُزِّ وَالخُبْز، وَتَقولُ «كَثير» وَ«قَليل».

dialogue.ar: صَباحَ الخَيْرِ يا فارِس! إِلى أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ؟
dialogue.tr: ṣabāḥa l-khayr yā Fāris! ilā ayna tadhhab?
dialogue.en: Good morning, Faris! Where are you going?
dialogue.ur: Subah bakhair Faris! Aap kahan ja rahe hain?

dialogue.ar: صَباحَ النّورِ. أَذْهَبُ إِلى المَطْعَمِ مَعَ أَبي.
dialogue.tr: ṣabāḥa n-nūr. adhhabu ilā l-maṭʿami maʿa abī
dialogue.en: Good morning. I am going to the restaurant with my father.
dialogue.ur: Subah bakhair. Main abbu ke saath restaurant ja raha hoon.

dialogue.ar: أَنا آكُلُ في البَيْتِ: الفُطورُ وَالغَداءُ وَالعَشاءُ، هَذِهِ ثَلاثُ وَجَباتٍ.
dialogue.tr: ana ākulu fī l-bayt: al-futūru wal-ghadāʾu wal-ʿashāʾ, hādhihi thalāthu wajabāt
dialogue.en: I eat at home: breakfast, lunch and dinner, these are three meals.
dialogue.ur: Main ghar par khata hoon: nashta, dopahar ka khaana aur raat ka khaana, yeh teen khaane hain.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا آكُلُ أَرْبَعَ وَجَباتٍ في اليَوْمِ!
dialogue.tr: wa ana ākulu arbaʿa wajabātin fī l-yawm!
dialogue.en: And I eat four meals a day!
dialogue.ur: Aur main din mein chaar khaane khata hoon!

dialogue.ar: أَرْبَعُ وَجَباتٍ؟ هَذا كَثيرٌ جِدّاً يا فارِس!
dialogue.tr: arbaʿu wajabāt? hādhā kathīrun jiddan yā Fāris!
dialogue.en: Four meals? That is very much, Faris!
dialogue.ur: Chaar khaane? Yeh bohat zyada hai Faris!

dialogue.tr: al-wajbatu r-rābiʿatu qalīlah, fākihatun wa khubz
dialogue.en: The fourth meal is small, fruit and bread.
dialogue.ur: Chautha khaana thora sa hai, phal aur roti.

dialogue.en: And what is in today's lunch?
dialogue.ur: Aur aaj ke dopahar ke khaane mein kya hai?

dialogue.en: Fish, rice and salad. And you?
dialogue.ur: Machli, chawal aur salad. Aur aap?

dialogue.en: I eat chicken, bread and fruit.
dialogue.ur: Main murghi, roti aur phal khata hoon.

dialogue.en: What is your weight, Majid?
dialogue.ur: Majid, aap ka wazan kitna hai?

dialogue.ar: خَمْسونَ كيلو هُوَ وَزْني. وَأَنْتَ يا فارِس؟
dialogue.tr: khamsūna kīlū huwa waznī. wa anta yā Fāris?
dialogue.en: Fifty kilos is my weight. And you, Faris?
dialogue.ur: Pachaas kilo mera wazan hai. Aur aap Faris?

dialogue.ar: وَزْني سَبْعونَ كيلو، فَأَنا سَمينٌ وَأَنْتَ نَحيفٌ!
dialogue.tr: waznī sabʿūna kīlū, fa-ana samīnun wa anta naḥīf!
dialogue.en: My weight is seventy kilos, so I am plump and you are thin!
dialogue.ur: Mera wazan sattar kilo hai, to main motaa hoon aur aap dubley hain!

dialogue.en: Let us go to the restaurant!
dialogue.ur: Chalein restaurant chalte hain!

dialogue.en: Let us go, for I am hungry!
dialogue.ur: Chalein, kyunke main bhooka hoon!

q.ur: فَطور ka matlab kya hai?
Kaun sa lafz 'chawal' ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني طَعاماً أَبْيَضَ نَطْبُخُهُ في الحَبَّات؟

q.en: How many meals does Faris eat in a day?
q.ur: Faris din mein kitne khaane khata hai?
q.ar: كَمْ وَجْبَةً يَأْكُلُ فارِسٌ في اليَوْم؟

q.ur: نَحيف ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which question asks 'Where are you going?'
q.ur: Kaun sa sawal 'Aap kahan ja rahe hain?' hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ نَسْأَلُ بِهِ عَنِ المَكانِ الَّذي يَذْهَبُ إِلَيْهِ الشَّخْص؟

intro.en: A flight attendant asks a passenger what he would like to eat and drink. Learn how to ask politely using 'min fadlik' (please) and 'shukran' (thank you).
intro.ur: Jahaz ki mezban musafir se poochti hai ke woh kya khana aur peena chahega. Hum 'min fadlik' (meherbani) aur 'shukran' (shukriya) ke saath adab se maangna seekhenge.
intro.ar: تَسْأَلُ مُضيفَةُ الطّائِرَةِ المُسافِرَ ماذا يُريدُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ وَيَشْرَب. تَتَعَلَّمُ الطَّلَبَ بِأَدَبٍ بِقَوْلِكَ «مِنْ فَضْلِكَ» وَالشُّكْرَ بِقَوْلِكَ «شُكْراً».

dialogue.ar: أَهْلاً بِكَ يا سَيِّدي! ماذا تَطْلُبُ مِنَ الطَّعامِ؟
dialogue.tr: ahlan bika yā sayyidī! mādhā taṭlubu mina ṭ-ṭaʿām?
dialogue.en: Welcome, sir! What would you like of food?
dialogue.ur: Khush aamdeed janab! Aap khane mein kya lenge?

dialogue.en: I would like chicken and bread, please.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe murghi aur roti chahiye, meherbani.

dialogue.en: And what would you like of drink?
dialogue.ur: Aur peene ke liye kya lenge?

dialogue.en: Some water, please.
dialogue.ur: Thora sa pani, meherbani.

dialogue.en: Do you prefer tea or coffee?
dialogue.ur: Aap chai pasand karte hain ya coffee?

dialogue.en: I prefer tea with milk.
dialogue.ur: Main doodh wali chai pasand karta hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ تُريدُ بَعْضَ الفاكِهَةِ؟ لَدَيْنا التَّمْرُ وَالعِنَبُ.
dialogue.tr: wa hal turīdu baʿḍa l-fākihah? ladaynā t-tamru wal-ʿinab
dialogue.en: And would you like some fruit? We have dates and grapes.
dialogue.ur: Aur kya aap kuch phal lenge? Hamare paas khajoor aur angoor hain.

dialogue.en: Yes, I would like some grapes.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, mujhe thore angoor chahiye.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلْ، هَذا هُوَ الطَّعامُ وَهَذا هُوَ الشَّرابُ.
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍal, hādhā huwa ṭ-ṭaʿāmu wa hādhā huwa sh-sharāb
dialogue.en: Here you are, this is the food and this is the drink.
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye, yeh khaana hai aur yeh peene ki cheez hai.

dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka shukriya.

dialogue.ar: عَفْواً يا سَيِّدي. أَتُريدُ شَيْئاً آخَرَ؟
dialogue.tr: ʿafwan yā sayyidī. a-turīdu shayʾan ākhar?
dialogue.en: You are welcome, sir. Would you like anything else?
dialogue.ur: Koi baat nahin janab. Kya aap kuch aur chahenge?

dialogue.en: No, thank you.
dialogue.ur: Nahin, shukriya.

dialogue.en: Have a pleasant flight!
dialogue.ur: Aap ka safar mubarak ho!

q.ur: عِنَب ka matlab kya hai?
Kaun sa lafz 'mashroob' (peene ki cheez) hai?

q.en: What does the passenger prefer: tea or coffee?
q.ur: Musafir kya pasand karta hai: chai ya coffee?
مِنْ فَضْلِكَ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What do you say after شُكْراً to reply 'You are welcome'?
q.ur: شُكْراً ke jawab mein 'Koi baat nahin' kya kehte hain?

title.en: Dialogue 3: Lunch is on the table

intro.en: A hungry husband comes home and finds a table full of food. His wife asks him to wait, because there are guests too! Learn words for husband, wife, guests, meat and chicken.
intro.ur: Bhooka shauhar ghar aata hai aur dastarkhwan par bohat sa khaana dekhta hai. Biwi kehti hai ke intezar karein, kyunke mehmaan bhi hain! Hum shauhar, biwi, mehmaan, gosht aur murghi ke alfaaz seekhenge.
intro.ar: يَعودُ الزَّوْجُ جائِعاً إلى البَيْتِ فَيَرى مائِدَةً عامِرَة. تَطْلُبُ مِنْهُ زَوْجَتُهُ أَنْ يَنْتَظِر، لِأَنَّ عِنْدَهُمْ ضُيوفاً! تَتَعَلَّمُ: زَوْج، زَوْجَة، ضُيوف، لَحْم، دَجاج.

dialogue.en: Welcome home, my husband.
dialogue.ur: Khush aamdeed mere shauhar.

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم يا زَوْجَتي. أَنا جَوْعانُ.
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalaykum yā zawjatī. ana jawʿān
dialogue.en: Peace be upon you, my wife. I am hungry.
dialogue.ur: Assalam o alaikum meri biwi. Main bhooka hoon.

dialogue.en: Please, the table is ready.
dialogue.ur: Tashreef laiye, dastarkhwan tayyar hai.

dialogue.ar: ما شاءَ اللهُ! هَذِهِ سَلَطَةٌ وَهَذا لَحْمٌ وَهَذا دَجاجٌ. هَذا طَعامٌ كَثيرٌ.
dialogue.tr: mā shāʾa llāh! hādhihi salaṭatun wa hādhā laḥmun wa hādhā dajāj. hādhā ṭaʿāmun kathīr
dialogue.en: Masha Allah! This is salad, this is meat and this is chicken. This is a lot of food.
dialogue.ur: Masha Allah! Yeh salad hai, yeh gosht hai aur yeh murghi hai. Yeh bohat khaana hai.

dialogue.ar: اِجْلِسْ يا زَوْجي، وَلا تَأْكُلْ الآنَ.
dialogue.tr: ijlis yā zawjī, wa lā taʾkul al-ān
dialogue.en: Sit down, my husband, and do not eat now.
dialogue.ur: Baith jaiye, aur abhi mat khaiye.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا يا زَوْجَتي؟ أَنا جَوْعانُ جِدّاً.
dialogue.tr: li-mādhā yā zawjatī? ana jawʿānu jiddan
dialogue.en: Why, my wife? I am very hungry.
dialogue.ur: Kyun meri biwi? Main bohat bhooka hoon.

dialogue.en: Because we have guests today.
dialogue.ur: Is liye ke aaj hamare haan mehmaan hain.

dialogue.en: Guests? Who are the guests?
dialogue.ur: Mehmaan? Mehmaan kaun hain?

dialogue.en: My mother, my father and my sister.
dialogue.ur: Meri ammi, mere abbu aur meri behan.

dialogue.en: And where are they now?
dialogue.ur: Aur woh abhi kahan hain?

dialogue.en: They are in the garden.
dialogue.ur: Woh bagh mein hain.

dialogue.en: Fine, I will sit with the guests.
dialogue.ur: Theek hai, main mehmanon ke saath baithoonga.

q.ur: ضُيوف ka matlab kya hai?
Kaun sa lafz 'biwi' ke liye hai?

q.en: Why does the wife tell the husband not to eat?
q.ur: Biwi shauhar ko khaane se kyun rokti hai?
q.ar: لِماذا تَطْلُبُ الزَّوْجَةُ مِنْ زَوْجِها ألّا يَأْكُل؟

q.ur: أَنا جَوْعانُ ka matlab kya hai?
Mehmaan kahan hain?

intro.en: Here you practise food and drink words, then learn the ordinal numbers: first, second, third, fourth and fifth.
intro.ur: Yahan hum khaane peene ke alfaaz ki mashq karenge, phir tarteebi ginti seekhenge: pehla, doosra, teesra, chautha aur paanchwan.
intro.ar: تَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى كَلِماتِ الطَّعامِ وَالشَّرابِ، ثُمَّ تَتَعَلَّمُ الأَعْدادَ التَّرْتيبِيَّة: الأُولى، الثّانِيَة، الثّالِثَة، الرّابِعَة، الخامِسَة.

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'pehli' (muannas) ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى المَرْتَبَةِ الأولى لِلْمُؤَنَّث؟

q.ur: الخامِسَة ka matlab kya hai?
Kaun sa lafz 'teesri' ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى المَرْتَبَةِ الثّالِثَة؟

q.en: Which of these is a drink?
q.ur: In mein se kaun si peene ki cheez hai?

intro.en: Learn useful sentence patterns: 'Where is the lunch?', 'I eat...', 'What do you eat?', 'Some of...' and 'What do you ask for?'. Just swap in different words.
intro.ur: Kaam ke jumlon ke saanche seekhein: 'Khaana kahan hai?', 'Main khata hun...', 'Aap kya khate hain?', 'Thora sa...' aur 'Aap kya maangte hain?'. Bas alfaaz badalte jaayen.
intro.ar: تَتَعَلَّمُ أَنْماطَ جُمَلٍ مُفيدَة: أَيْنَ الغَداء؟ آكُلُ... ماذا تَأْكُلُ؟ بَعْضُ... ماذا تَطْلُب؟ بَدِّلِ الكَلِماتِ فَقَط.

dialogue.en: Where is the bread?
dialogue.ur: Roti kahan hai?

dialogue.en: The bread is on the table.
dialogue.ur: Roti dastarkhwan par hai.

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'kahan' ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ المَكان؟

q.ur: عَلى ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Complete: ماذا ___ في الغَداءِ؟ (What do you eat for lunch?)
q.ur: Mukammal karein: ماذا ___ في الغَداءِ؟ (Aap dopahar ko kya khate hain?)
بَعْض ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Listen carefully to two similar letters. ق (qāf) is deep in the throat. ك (kāf) is light and in the front of the mouth. Hear the difference in قَهْوَة (coffee) and كَثير (a lot).
intro.ur: Do milte julte huroof ko dhyan se sunein. ق (qaaf) halq ki gehrai se nikalta hai. ك (kaaf) halka hai aur munh ke aage se nikalta hai. Farq sunein: قَهْوَة (coffee) aur كَثير (bohat).
intro.ar: أَصْغِ جَيِّداً إلى حَرْفَيْنِ مُتَشابِهَيْن. القافُ ق صَوْتُها عَميقٌ في الحَلْق، وَالكافُ ك خَفيفَةٌ في مُقَدِّمَةِ الفَم. اسْمَعِ الفَرْقَ في «قَهْوَة» وَ«كَثير».

q.en: Which letter is pronounced deep in the throat?
q.ur: Kaun sa harf halq ki gehrai se bola jata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يَخْرُجُ عَميقاً مِنَ الحَلْق؟

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz ق se shuru hota hai?
Kaun sa lafz ك se shuru hota hai?
قالوا ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Now practise speaking with a friend. Ask what they eat and drink, what they would like, and how many meals they eat each day.
intro.ur: Ab dost ke saath bol kar mashq karein. Poochein woh kya khata peeta hai, kya maangta hai, aur din mein kitne khaane khata hai.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الكَلامِ مَعَ صَديقِك: اسْأَلْهُ ماذا يَأْكُلُ وَيَشْرَب، وَماذا يُحِبُّ، وَكَمْ وَجْبَةً يَأْكُلُ كُلَّ يَوْم.

dialogue.en: What do you drink at breakfast?
dialogue.ur: Aap nashte mein kya peete hain?

dialogue.en: I drink milk.
dialogue.ur: Main doodh peeta hoon.

dialogue.en: And what do you eat?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap kya khate hain?

dialogue.en: I eat bread and dates.
dialogue.ur: Main roti aur khajoor khata hoon.

dialogue.en: Are you hungry?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap bhooke hain?

dialogue.en: Yes, I am hungry.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, main bhooka hoon.

dialogue.en: Here you are, this is the bread.
dialogue.ur: Ye lijiye, yeh roti hai.

dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya.

q.en: How do you ask 'What do you eat?'
q.ur: 'Aap kya khate hain?' kaise poochte hain?

q.en: How do you say 'I drink tea'?
q.ur: 'Main chai peeta hun' Arabic mein kaise kehte hain?

q.en: Which word begins a yes/no question?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz haan/na wale sawal ko shuru karta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِها سُؤالاً جَوابُهُ نَعَمْ أَوْ لا؟

q.en: What do you say to ask politely for some fish?
q.ur: Adab se thori machli maangne ke liye kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا تَقولُ لِتَطْلُبَ بَعْضَ السَّمَكِ بِأَدَب؟

intro.en: Read a short paragraph about Najwa and what she eats and drinks every day. Practise reading carefully, then answer questions.
intro.ur: Najwa ke baare mein chhota sa paragraph parhein ke woh roz kya khati peeti hai. Dhyan se parhein aur phir sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: اقْرَأْ فِقْرَةً قَصيرَةً عَنْ نَجْوى وَما تَأْكُلُهُ وَتَشْرَبُهُ كُلَّ يَوْم. اقْرَأْ بِانْتِباه ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَة.

dialogue.ar: نَجْوى نَحيفَةٌ وَجَميلَةٌ. تَأْكُلُ أَرْبَعَ وَجَباتٍ في اليَوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: Najwā naḥīfatun wa jamīlah. taʾkulu arbaʿa wajabātin fī l-yawm
dialogue.en: Najwa is thin and pretty. She eats four meals a day.
dialogue.ur: Najwa dubli aur khoobsurat hai. Woh din mein chaar khaane khati hai.

dialogue.ar: في الفُطورِ تَأْكُلُ نَجْوى الخُبْزَ وَالتَّمْرَ وَتَشْرَبُ الحَليبَ، وَفي الغَداءِ تَأْكُلُ الأَرُزَّ وَالدَّجاجَ وَتَشْرَبُ الماءَ.
dialogue.tr: fī l-futūri taʾkulu Najwā l-khubza wat-tamra wa tashrabu l-ḥalīb, wa fī l-ghadāʾi taʾkulu l-aruzza wad-dajāja wa tashrabu l-māʾ
dialogue.en: At breakfast Najwa eats bread and dates and drinks milk, and at lunch she eats rice and chicken and drinks water.
dialogue.ur: Nashte mein Najwa roti aur khajoor khati aur doodh peeti hai, aur dopahar mein chawal aur murghi khati aur pani peeti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَفي العَشاءِ تَأْكُلُ السَّلَطَةَ وَالفاكِهَةَ وَتَشْرَبُ الشّايَ. وَزْنُ نَجْوى خَمْسونَ كيلو.
dialogue.tr: wa fī l-ʿashāʾi taʾkulu s-salaṭata wal-fākihata wa tashrabu sh-shāy. waznu Najwā khamsūna kīlū
dialogue.en: At dinner she eats salad and fruit and drinks tea. Najwa's weight is fifty kilos.
dialogue.ur: Raat ko woh salad aur phal khati aur chai peeti hai. Najwa ka wazan pachaas kilo hai.

vocab.ur: woh khati hai / aap khate hain
woh peeti hai / aap peete hain

q.en: How many meals does Najwa eat a day?
q.ur: Najwa din mein kitne khaane khati hai?
q.ar: كَمْ وَجْبَةً تَأْكُلُ نَجْوى في اليَوْم؟

q.en: What does Najwa drink at breakfast?
q.ur: Najwa nashte mein kya peeti hai?

q.en: What does Najwa eat at dinner?
q.ur: Najwa raat ko kya khati hai?
Najwa ka wazan kitna hai?

intro.en: Learn how the letters ك, ل, ن, ف, ق and م change shape at the start, middle and end of a word. Then listen and review the whole unit.
intro.ur: Seekhein ke huroof ك، ل، ن، ف، ق aur م lafz ke shuru, beech aur aakhir mein kaise shakl badalte hain. Phir pori unit ki dohrai karein.
intro.ar: تَتَعَلَّمُ كَيْفَ تَتَغَيَّرُ أَشْكالُ الحُروفِ ك ل ن ف ق م في أَوَّلِ الكَلِمَةِ وَوَسَطِها وَآخِرِها. ثُمَّ تَسْتَمِعُ وَتُراجِعُ الوَحْدَةَ كُلَّها.

q.en: Which word starts with the letter ك?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz harf ك se shuru hota hai?

q.en: Which word starts with the letter ل?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz harf ل se shuru hota hai?
لِماذا ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word starts with the letter ف?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz harf ف se shuru hota hai?

q.en: What is the opposite of نَعَمْ?
q.ur: نَعَمْ ka ulta kya hai?
